evaluation_summary: 100-client GNS3 replay experiment using anonymized social-message timing; No-TDA/TDA accuracy: DoH 100/100, DoT 100/99, DoH+VPN 96/93, DoT+VPN 68/34 percent.
code_data_note: Simulation described; independent code/data reproduction not verified.
assessment: Assessment: these comparisons provide negative incremental evidence for TDA in this design, not a universal negative result.
rubric_notes: R1: same simulation and NCC matcher, but Table II compares best multivariate (TDA-transformed) vs best univariate (no TDA) setups (Sec IV.G), so inputs differ; R2: no cheap multivariate reducer (sum, mean, PCA) replacing the persistence-landscape L2 collapse; R3: no train/test separation; TDA hyperparameters grid-searched and best-performing setup per scope reported (Sec III.C, IV.B) on the same simulated data; R4: argmax NCC (no threshold) but configuration selected on evaluation outcomes (Sec IV.B); R5: closed-set top-1 accuracy and recall@k among 100 simulated clients; no false-attribution rate at realistic candidate-pool size; R6: single 100-client simulation, no variance; R7: only asymptotic complexity (Alg 1-5); PH called expensive (Sec III.C); no measured cost; R8: no noise/drift tests; only notes that adding unhelpful features can cut accuracy up to 30% (Sec IV.E); R9: VPN stacking evaluated as a privacy tool, not a timing-aware adversary; R11: losses attributed to TDA compression and DoT+VPN drop called unexplained (Sec IV.G, V), speculative; claim that TDA removes noise (Sec III.C) untested; R12: no code; R13: Reddit corpus public via ConvoKit (ref 17); simulated captures not released
CHG: Identity (persona-to-source-IP attribution; signal = per-IP activity-timing series)
comparator_numbers: Author, Table II ('Preservation of POL when TDA is used'), No-TDA vs TDA accuracy: DoH 100% vs 100%; DoT 100% vs 99%; DoH+VPN 96% vs 93%; DoT+VPN 68% vs 34%
round_notes: TDA = per-window Vietoris-Rips -> persistence landscapes -> L2 norm, collapsing a multivariate series to univariate (Sec III.C, Alg 5).
